rubric_hint.rule: 1 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: One eligible species, Goodyera repens (VU, vascular plant), has records 289-365 m from the polygon (2023, uncertainty 25 m). Lack of dead wood is among its threats. It is just outside the 250 m ring, so none are eligible within 250 m.

Many site-bound forest NT species are recorded within 1000 m, with the nearest at 273 m. None of them is within 250 m, so the 3-species NT rule is not met. Within 250 m only the mobile NT bird Poecile montanus (147 m) is recorded.
Effort is adequate (225 records within 1000 m, 80th percentile). There are 26 records within 250 m and none inside the polygon.
Only 4.0% of the polygon overlaps completed fellings from 2019 and 2021, so it is not already felled.

uncertainties: The eligible record is 39 m beyond the 250 m ring boundary, so the ring cut-off largely decides the MEDIUM rather than HIGH outcome.
Records show a species was recorded, not that it occupies the polygon today.
One coarse record within 250 m was dropped for uncertainty.
not_established: Whether any red-listed species occurs in the polygon.
The stand's age, structure or habitat quality.
That the site is safe to fell.
next_action: A reviewer should check the stand, especially its dead wood and old trees, in the area between the polygon and the Goodyera repens and NT lichen and fungus records 270-420 m away. The reviewer should also check whether the polygon is connected to that habitat.
